label: Diagram 3.13
caption: Diagram 3.13 Floor type 2.1C(b) – floor type 2.1 with ceiling treatment C and floating floor (b)
description:
The image is a cross‑section drawing, framed by a rectangular border, with the word "SECTION" printed in the lower right corner. Above the frame, a pale green title block reads: "Diagram 3.13 Floor type 2.1C(b) – floor type 2.1 with ceiling treatment C and floating floor (b)".

The section itself shows a horizontal floor assembly made up of stacked layers. The topmost layer is a rectangular band filled with a speckled, stippled pattern. Directly beneath it is a thin horizontal band drawn with a closely spaced diagonal zig‑zag or hatched pattern. Below that sits a thicker rectangular layer, again rendered with the same speckled, stippled texture. Along the underside of this lower layer are three small, evenly spaced symbols, each shaped like a shallow rectangle with a cross (X) inside. These symbols rest on top of a single thin horizontal line or plate that runs along the very bottom of the drawing. No dimensions, arrows or additional text labels appear on the construction elements themselves.
